name: Seated Hamstring Stretch
description: Sitting with one leg straight and the other foot against its inner thigh, hinge forward from your hips with a flat back and reach toward your ankle.

source.title: A guide to basic stretches (Mayo Clinic)
source.note: From your full-body routine, described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Sit on a mat with your left leg straight out and your right foot tucked against your left inner thigh.
cues: Sit tall first, then hinge forward from your hips.
Keep your back flat; don't round your shoulders.
Reach toward your ankle or toes until you feel the stretch.

prescription.note: Hold 30 to 45 seconds and breathe slowly.

keyframes.name: Sit tall
keyframes.cue: Left leg straight, right foot at your inner thigh.

keyframes.name: Hinge forward
keyframes.cue: Hinge forward with a flat back, reaching for your ankle.
